title: Adaptive batching + cache-eviction eval playbook for latency-quality regressions
creator: Tomás Rivera
description: Goal: Produce a repeatable evaluation playbook and automated harness to measure latency-vs-quality tradeoffs across adaptive batching and prefix/kv cache eviction policies. Outcome should be clear rollout gates (metrics + thresholds) and an automated regression monitor that runs against precommitted prompt sets and human-eval cohorts. Background: recent changes to dynamic microbatching and an LRU-based cache eviction prototype reduced per-token cost on high-throughput workloads but had anecdotal quality regressions on long-context generation. This ticket scopes an end-to-end evaluation plan, artifacts, and a short experiment run to inform rollout policy.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible benchmark harness (script + config) that sweeps microbatch_size, max_batch_latency_ms, cache_enabled, cache_eviction_policy (LRU/LFU), and cache_ttl_ms

Baseline and candidate configs produce a results artifact stored in S3 with clear metrics: latency (P50/P95/P99), token throughput, cost-per-token estimate, embedding-similarity vs reference, answer-exactness (EM), hallucination-rate proxy, and human-A/B score for a 200-sample cohort
Automated regression alerts set: quality degradation >2% on embedding-sim or >1.5% absolute EM drop triggers block for rollout
Playbook docs (Confluence link) and rollout gating checklist added to release pipeline for runtime-1.22
One can run the harness in CI with a 30-minute smoke sweep that exercises the 'latency-sensitive' and 'throughput-optimized' profiles
test_plan: Prepare datasets: 2k representative prompts from production (anonymized), 500 long-context prompts (>2k tokens), 200 human-eval cases with diversified templates
Define workload profiles: latency-sensitive (SLO P95 <= 200ms for short prompts), throughput-optimized (maximize tokens/sec under cost cap), and mixed/retrieval-augmented
Implement parameter sweep: microbatch_size in [1,2,4,8], max_batch_latency_ms in [10,25,50,100], cache_enabled in [true,false], cache_ttl_ms in [0,1000,10000], eviction in [LRU,LFU]
Run baseline (current stable config) 3x and candidate configs 3x each, collect latency and quality metrics; seed RNG to reduce variance
Compute metrics and diff vs baseline: relative delta for latency percentiles, absolute delta for quality metrics, and cost-per-token estimates using rollout pricing model
Human A/B blind eval for top 3 promising candidates vs baseline: collect preference and clarity scores
Summarize results in dashboard and generate rollout recommendation (allowlist configs, canary thresholds, auto-rollback rules)
notes: We must ensure test harness uses identical model weights and tokenizer across runs; any quantization variant is a separate axis. Keep burst capacity disabled to emulate constrained dedicated pools. Also include streaming vs non-streaming runs for short prompts to capture tail latency behavior.
